title: Supply Chain Disruption Alert, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Supply Chain Disruption Alert agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

names.manual: Supply Chain D A Studio Manual
Supply Chain Disruption Alert Workspace Manual

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 5 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Supply Chain Disruption Alert Supply Routes list.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Asia-Pacific Primary (SupplyRouteId RT-APAC-01), with Origin Shenzhen, China.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Supply Chain Disrupt A Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 5 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Customer Fulfillment Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which active disruption has the largest modeled impact and what is affected?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: DISR-002; $3,800,000.00; SKU-1010. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Supply Chain Planner
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Asia-Pacific Primary; HIGH; Weather. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Operations Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft a DISR-002 mitigation scenario without rerouting or moving inventory.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: DISR-002; Draft Disruption Mitigation Scenario; no purchase order. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Procurement Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show Electronics alternatives without activating a supplier.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: TechSource Taiwan; due diligence; human approval. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Supply Chain Disruption Alert: 5 read-only tabs from the same lists. 5 fictional records, including Asia-Pacific Primary (SupplyRouteId RT-APAC-01), with Origin Shenzhen, China.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Supply Chain Disruption Alert Supply Routes from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload supply-routes.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set SupplyRouteId, Origin, Destination, TransportMode, Carriers, Categories, CurrentStatus to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep TransitDays, AnnualVolumeTeu, AnnualValueUSD, ReliabilityScore as Number. Name the list Supply Chain Disruption Alert Supply Routes. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Asia-Pacific Primary (SupplyRouteId RT-APAC-01), with Origin Shenzhen, China.

steps.title: Create Supply Chain Disruption Alert Disruption Events from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload disruption-events.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set DisruptionEventId, Type, Severity, AffectedRoutes, StartDate, EstimatedResolution, AffectedSKUS, Description, Status to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep DelayDays, EstimatedRevenueImpact as Number. Name the list Supply Chain Disruption Alert Disruption Events. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Port Congestion — Los Angeles/Long Beach (DisruptionEventId DISR-001), with Type port_congestion.

steps.title: Create Supply Chain Disruption Alert Risk Scores from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload risk-scores.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RiskScoreId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep OverallRisk, Geopolitical, Weather, Infrastructure, Labor, Regulatory, Financial as Number. Name the list Supply Chain Disruption Alert Risk Scores. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including RT-APAC-01 (RiskScoreId RT-APAC-01), with OverallRisk 0.78.

steps.title: Create Supply Chain Disruption Alert Mitigation Playbooks from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload mitigation-playbooks.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set MitigationPlaybookId, ImmediateActions, ShortTermActions, LongTermActions to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep EstimatedMitigationCost, RiskReductionPct as Number. Name the list Supply Chain Disruption Alert Mitigation Playbooks. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Port Congestion Mitigation (MitigationPlaybookId port_congestion), with EstimatedMitigationCost 340000.0.

steps.title: Create Supply Chain Disruption Alert Alternative Suppliers from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload alternative-suppliers.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AlternativeSupplierId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Supply Chain Disruption Alert Alternative Suppliers. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Electronics (AlternativeSupplierId Electronics).

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Supply Chain D A Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 5 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload supply-chain-disruption-alert-rules-and-controls.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the supply routes tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Chain Disruption Alert Supply Routes; name the tool Get supply route records.
steps.expected: Get supply route records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the disruption events tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Chain Disruption Alert Disruption Events; name the tool Get disruption event records.
steps.expected: Get disruption event records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the risk scores tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Chain Disruption Alert Risk Scores; name the tool Get risk score records.
steps.expected: Get risk score records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the mitigation playbooks tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Chain Disruption Alert Mitigation Playbooks; name the tool Get mitigation playbook records.
steps.expected: Get mitigation playbook records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the alternative suppliers tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Supply Chain Disruption Alert Alternative Suppliers; name the tool Get alternative supplier records.
steps.expected: Get alternative supplier records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 5 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 5 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: supply-chain-disruption-alert-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 5 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Supply Routes" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Disruption Events" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Risk Scores" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Mitigation Playbooks" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Alternative Suppliers" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 5 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Supply Chain Disruption Alert Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Supply Chain Disruption Alert Supply Routes tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 5 fictional records, including Asia-Pacific Primary (SupplyRouteId RT-APAC-01), with Origin Shenzhen, China.
